title: Tracecat 1.0.0-beta.52-rc.12
body_markdown:
## Integrations


- retire broken MCP catalog stdio recipes ([#3312](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3312) )
- revamp Google integrations with multi-source auth ([#3310](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3310) )
- add a user OAuth grant to google_admin ([#3314](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3314) )
- add delete action for custom OAuth providers ([#3320](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3320) )
- add the Google SecOps remote MCP catalog row ([#3323](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3323) )
- add Google Chronicle actions ([#3322](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3322) )


## Agents


- configurable timeouts ([#3050](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3050) )
- grant required session execution scopes ([#3308](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3308) )
- add agent session interaction model ([#3315](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3315) )
- propagate agent session provenance ([#3319](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3319) )


## Performance improvements


- avoid reloading registry templates ([#3321](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3321) )


## Bug fixes


- cap linked rows per table and paginate the case grids ([#3309](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3309) )
- polish MCP catalog badges, logos, and empty state ([#3318](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3318) )


## Documentation


- run workflows from comments with a slash command ([#3305](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3305) )
- link table rows from the case page ([#3307](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3307) )
- move custom registry management into org settings ([#3304](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3304) )


## Other


- expression reference, cheatsheets, and navigation reorg ([#3296](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3296) )
- Manage platform pages, agent timeouts, and org enrollment ([#3298](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3298) )
- split EE RBAC pages, make user management UI-driven ([#3300](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3300) )
- define versioned error envelope ([#3267](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3267) )
- add version history restore flow ([#3301](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3301) )
- clarify Enterprise license requirement ([#3311](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3311) )
- clarify secret environment use cases ([#3317](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3317) )


**Full changelog** :[1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.12](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.0.0-beta.52-rc.11...1.0.0-beta.52-rc.12)
